6904.title: Codex routing changes persisted provider identity
6904.rootCauseOneLine: Pooling selects a launch-only custom provider id that Codex persists, coupling chat resumability to routing mode.
6904.proposedFix: Separate stable chat identity from authenticated transport routing and cover both historical provider ids before implementation.
6904.caveats: Both clean runs reproduce pool-to-local failure on Codex 0.159.0; the reported 0.166.0 forward-direction mismatch error remains unverified. No fix PR because authentication-routing or stored-data compatibility changes exceed the simple-fix safety boundary. Reproduction test and output are inline under site policy.
